description: Which skill does the agent load for a given request? The descriptions in the skill frontmatter are the routing signal; these cases are the regression spec for them. The first entry in expected_skills is the primary skill.

evals.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph so it reads like a standards deliverable and drop the vague claims.
evals.note: Prose quality of standards text, not document mechanics.

evals.prompt: In an ETSI contribution, do we write 'organisation' or 'organization', and how do we write dates and ranges?
evals.note: Mechanical conventions belong to the writing skill, not to the drafting skill.

evals.prompt: Check this draft for generic filler like 'state of the art' and for claims we cannot support.
evals.note: The self-check list of the writing skill.

evals.prompt: Set the caption numbering on these figures and make the text refer to Table 3 automatically.
evals.note: SEQ and REF field codes are a DOCX operation.

evals.prompt: The equation numbering in clause 5 is wrong. Fix it without breaking the rest of the document.
evals.note: Equation and table counters, applied through named styles.

evals.prompt: Apply the proper note style to the three notes under clause 4.2 and make them a numbered list.
evals.note: Note styles and enumerations, with the SDO style-name map.

evals.prompt: How do I insert a bookmark and a cross-reference so the reference updates when the numbering changes?
evals.note: Bookmarks and field codes.

evals.prompt: I need to start an ETSI TS. Which skeleton do I take and what are the clauses?
evals.note: Skeleton selection and deliverable structure.

evals.prompt: What does a 3GPP contribution (TDoc) look like - which sections and which header fields?
evals.note: TDoc frontmatter and structure live in the drafting skill.

evals.prompt: How are the clauses of an ITU-T Recommendation with an appendix structured?
evals.note: ITU-T clause order and annex conventions, in the ITU-T reference tree.

evals.prompt: What patent obligations do I have when I submit a contribution to an ITU-T study group?
evals.note: The Common Patent Policy and the declaration forms.

evals.prompt: Our ETSI deliverable carries an IPR clause. May I rewrite it to be more precise?
evals.note: The IPR clause of a deliverable is protected: the agent answers from the policy skill and does not rewrite the clause.

evals.prompt: Set up a new project for the contribution I am starting next week.
evals.note: Project bootstrap: PLAN.md, AGENTS.md, directory layout.

evals.prompt: Keep the document properties of the deliverable in sync with PLAN.md.
evals.note: Metadata synchronisation, not formatting.

evals.prompt: What is the difference between an ETSI TS and a TR, and who approves each?
evals.note: Deliverable types and the lifecycle; the binding voting rules are in etsi-directives.

evals.prompt: Who is the Technical Officer, what does a working group do, and what is a rapporteur?
evals.note: Roles and terminology.

evals.prompt: How is a decision taken in ETSI - who may vote and what majority is needed?
evals.note: The Rules of Procedure decide this, not the overview skill.

evals.prompt: What does the ETSI IPR policy require of a chairman when a patent is declared in a meeting?
evals.note: Chairs' Annex C duties; the general IPR frame is in sdo-ipr.

evals.prompt: I want to submit a contribution to the next TC meeting. What do I have to do?
evals.note: The meeting and submission procedure.

evals.prompt: We need a new Work Item for the next release - who has to support it and what does the description look like?
evals.note: Work Item rules and the support threshold.

evals.prompt: How long does the ENAP route take, and what are the deadlines for the national public comment step?
evals.note: The approval routes and their clocks.

evals.prompt: What is the latest version of ETSI TS 103 224, and where do I download it?
evals.note: Specification metadata and download URLs.

evals.prompt: List the documents that are registered for the next ETSI TC meeting.
evals.note: The portal tooling answers the how; the procedures skill says what a meeting document is.

evals.prompt: Explain how 3GPP is organized and what the three TSGs cover.
evals.note: The organization overview.

evals.prompt: When is the next 3GPP SA plenary, and how are plenaries named?
evals.note: Meeting schedule and naming; TDoc numbers belong to 3gpp-tdocs.

evals.prompt: Give me the meeting schedule for the RAN working group meetings of this year.
evals.note: The meeting calendar.

evals.prompt: Which 3GPP working group owns this feature, and what is its tbid?
evals.note: Working group identifiers and the tbid mapping.

evals.prompt: Explain the RAN1 to RAN6 and SA1 to SA6 structure and how the SubTB numbers relate to it.
evals.note: Subgroup hierarchy and identifiers.

evals.prompt: What is Rel-19, when does it freeze, and which specifications are in it?
evals.note: Release structure, versioning and freeze.

evals.prompt: Where do I find the specification files for 3GPP TS 21.456 on the 3GPP file server?
evals.note: FTP directory structure for specifications; the TDoc folders are a different skill.

evals.prompt: What is the difference between 21.456.0 and 21.456.1, and how are spec versions numbered?
evals.note: Specification numbering and version format.

evals.prompt: What is the TDoc number for the RAN1 working group meeting in April 2026?
evals.note: TDoc number format and the meeting-code mapping.

evals.prompt: Crawl the meeting folder on the file server and tell me which TDocs are there; skip the inbox and the draft folders.
evals.note: TDoc discovery, subdirectory detection and the excluded directories.

evals.prompt: I have to submit a change request against TS 23.501. What is the CR number format and what goes on the cover sheet?
evals.note: CR format and the submission checklist.

evals.prompt: Our change request came back with a status code. What does it mean and what happens next in the CR lifecycle?
evals.note: CR status codes and the lifecycle.

evals.prompt: The 3GPP portal asks me to log in. How does that login work and how do I keep the session?
evals.note: EOL login and session handling.

evals.prompt: How is an ITU-T Recommendation structured and how does it get approved?
evals.note: Recommendation structure, annex conventions and the approval path.

evals.prompt: What is the difference between WTSA approval and TAP or AAP approval?
evals.note: Study group, TSAG and TSB; the approval methods.

evals.prompt: What does 'ITU-T | ISO/IEC common text' mean, and how do I write a requirement in a Recommendation?
evals.note: Common text and the modal verbs.

evals.prompt: How do I submit a contribution to the next ITU-T study group meeting, and when is the deadline?
evals.note: The submission procedure and the deadlines, from Rec. A.1 clause 3.

evals.prompt: Write a liaison statement to another ITU-T study group. What does the format require?
evals.note: The liaison statement format is part of the contribution rules.

evals.prompt: I have to build a document with a TDoc header, revision history and numbered clauses, and it has to pass the review - what is the order of work?
evals.note: A compound request: setup first, then the skeleton, then the mechanics.
